high: (They lean in. The chair creaks agreement.)
(A real smile — the eyes joined in this time.)
(They're mirroring your posture. Textbook, and working.)
(Their phone buzzes; they silence it without looking.)
mid: (They check the door once. Just once.)
(Arms uncrossed, but the pen is capped.)
low: (The watch check with the whole arm.)
(They've begun stacking papers that were already stacked.)
(A smile with all the warmth of a contract clause.)
(They just said 'anyway' to nothing. Land the plane.)
(The folder migrates back toward their bag.)

great: breezes in like the weekend grosses personally apologized to them
arrives mid-anecdote, and it's actually funny
is glowing. Someone said yes to them today
good: arrives on time, which around here is a love language
settles in with coffee for both of you. Both!
greets you by name. First AND last. Power move, taken kindly
neutral: gives the handshake of someone conserving battery
sits, aligns the chair, waits. All business today
bad: arrives with the energy of a delayed flight
is wearing sunglasses. Indoors. At a meeting
answers your hello with a sigh shaped like your name
awful: arrives twenty minutes of grievance in a ten-minute window
slams nothing, which is somehow worse
greets your assistant warmly and you not at all
